question.text: The current of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> flows in a square loop of sides <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> is placed in air. The magnetic field at the centre of the loop is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></math> is _________.

solution.text:
Magnetic field at the centre of the square loop is given by,

B=4μ0I4πdsin45°+sin45°, where d is perpendicular distance of the centre to one of its sides.

⇒B=4×μ0×54π×1212+12

=4×10-7×5×2×2

=402×10-7 T
